name: Asynchronous Chunk Loading
aliases: Asynchronous Chunk Loading — Async Voxel Generation
Asynchronous Chunk Loading — Async Voxel Generation, Chunk Task Queue
definition: Offloads chunk mesh generation to a thread pool using futures and callbacks, queuing results for the render thread via a task queue.
summary: Asynchronous Chunk Loading offloads mesh generation to background threads to prevent frame stutter, allowing players to interact with the world while chunks are generated.
